List of Candidates found not eligible for Attendant post
Friday, 09 February 2024
3116 Hits
Applications received for the post of Attendant have been scrutinized on the basis of criterion mentioned in the advertisement and finalization by the Scrutiny committee. Following applicants have been found to be not eligible in accordance with the eligibility criteria as mentioned in the advertisement.
Click here to check the list
In case if any of the applicant is not satisfied with the reasons for ineligibility he/she may submit his/her representation, supported by documents as evidence. Please contact MS Office (Personal Section) before 20th February 2024, up to 5.00 PM. No requests shall be entertained beyond the specified period. Representations without supporting documents will not be entertained.
Medical Superintendent
Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
